config.autofishplus.title: AutoFish+ Settings
config.autofishplus.enabled.tooltip: Automatically reels in when a fish bites and casts again after the delay.
config.autofishplus.recast_delay.tooltip: Pause between reeling in and casting the rod again.
config.autofishplus.dont_night_fishing.t: Stops auto-fishing while the world is dark outside.
config.autofishplus.replace_rod.tooltip: Moves another fishing rod into your selected hotbar slot when the current one breaks.
config.autofishplus.antiban.tooltip: Adds realistic non-normal human reaction delay (Ex-Gaussian) and recast jitter to simulate human hands.
config.autofishplus.mouse_jitter.tooltip: Simulates subtle natural mouse sensor movement when pressing the right click button to evade bot heuristics.
